plain: bringing goods in or out of a country illegally

webster.text: Importing or exporting goods contrary to law.

example.quote: It will be a principal object to guard against smuggling, and such other attacks on the revenue as other nations are subject to.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 11, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
